contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Replace all literal first occurrences with replacement, then replace all literal second occurrences in that intermediate result with replacement. Each pass leaves text unchanged for an empty target. The second pass may process output inserted by the first pass.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh.

inputRoles.first: literal target for the first substitution
inputRoles.second: literal target for the second substitution
inputRoles.replacement: literal text inserted in both passes

contract.outputRole: result after first substitution then second substitution
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
